(async()=>{const G=(await import('/js/flight/gtiles.js')).GT, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'), THREE=await import('three'); E.clock.paused=true; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const r=new THREE.Raycaster(); r.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(0,-0.6), E.camera); const hits=r.intersectObject(G.holder,true); const h=hits[0]; if(!h) return 'no hit'; const o=h.object, m=o.material; const img=m.map&&m.map.image; let par=o; const chain=[]; while(par&&chain.length<6){chain.push(par.type+':'+(par.name||'').slice(0,20)); par=par.parent;} window.__hitMesh=o; return JSON.stringify({dist:+h.distance.toFixed(1), point:h.point.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)), camY:+E.camera.position.y.toFixed(1), mat:m.type, side:m.side, hasMap:!!m.map, img: img? [img.width,img.height, img.constructor.name]:null, mapVersion: m.map&&m.map.version, color: m.color&&m.color.getHexString(), verts:o.geometry.attributes.position.count, chain, nHits: hits.length})})()

(()=>{const o=__hitMesh, im=o.material.map.image; const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=64; c.height=64; const g=c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(im,0,0,64,64); const d=g.getImageData(0,0,64,64).data; let s=[0,0,0]; for(let k=0;k<d.length;k+=4){s[0]+=d[k];s[1]+=d[k+1];s[2]+=d[k+2];} const n=d.length/4; const tex=o.material.map; return JSON.stringify({avg:s.map(v=>Math.round(v/n)), flipY:tex.flipY, cs:tex.colorSpace, gen:tex.generateMipmaps, min:tex.minFilter, pa:tex.premultiplyAlpha, uv: !!o.geometry.attributes.uv, uvRange: (()=>{const a=o.geometry.attributes.uv; if(!a) return null; let mn=[9,9],mx=[-9,-9]; for(let k=0;k<a.count;k++){mn[0]=Math.min(mn[0],a.getX(k));mx[0]=Math.max(mx[0],a.getX(k));mn[1]=Math.min(mn[1],a.getY(k));mx[1]=Math.max(mx[1],a.getY(k));} return [mn,mx];})(), attrs:Object.keys(o.geometry.attributes)})})()
(async()=>{const THREE=await import('three'); const t=__hitMesh.material.map; t.minFilter=THREE.LinearFilter; t.generateMipmaps=false; t.needsUpdate=true; return 1})()

(async()=>{const THREE=await import('three'); const im=__hitMesh.material.map.image; const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=im.width; c.height=im.height; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0); const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace; t.flipY=false; __hitMesh.material.map=t; __hitMesh.material.needsUpdate=true; return 1})()
